subject.title: fix(agents): tighten bash-tools schema fields from Type.Number to Type.Integer

question: Should `exec.yieldMs` become integer-only, or should this PR be narrowed away from that compatibility change?
rationale: Current docs and shipped schemas accept the broader number contract, while repository evidence does not establish that rejecting fractional values is an approved compatibility change.

options.title: Narrow to pagination
options.body: Drop `yieldMs` and select the proof-positive related PR as the canonical non-negative integer fix for `offset` and `limit`.

options.title: Approve integer yield
options.body: Keep `yieldMs` only with explicit contract approval, compatibility rationale, and direct exported-schema or live-tool proof.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Close or pause this competing branch if the related pagination PR is selected and no owner sponsors the separate `yieldMs` change.

recommendation.title: Narrow to pagination
recommendation.body: Drop `yieldMs` and select the proof-positive related PR as the canonical non-negative integer fix for `offset` and `limit`.

likelyOwner.reason: The process-tool history shows the strongest and most sustained connection to this runtime and its validation contracts.
